subject: Reschedule: Redwood platform demo — customer site visit conflict
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlanticmedical.com>, Natalie Perez <natalie.perez@atlanticmedical.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T14:03:00Z
Subject: Redwood demo — proposed time (May 25)

Hi Liam / Natalie,

Thanks again for the quick intro today. Per our conversation, I'd like to schedule a 45-minute demo of the Redwood inference platform that covers: deployment options, latency/cost tradeoffs, and an ops walkthrough for your infra team.

Proposed slot: Monday, May 25 at 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET — does that work for you?

Attached is a short agenda for the session (Agenda.pdf) — happy to tailor. If that time doesn't work, please share 2-3 alternatives and we'll find something that fits.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Agenda.pdf (1 page — demo topics and attendees)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlanticmedical.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed time (May 25)

Thanks Camila — appreciate the agenda.

Quick heads up: we have a scheduled site visit on May 25 (offsite rounds across two clinics) so I won't be available that morning. Would it be possible to move the demo to Wednesday, May 27 (any time before 2pm PT) or Tuesday, June 1?

Apologies for the inconvenience — we're very interested, just heavy site-travel that week.

Cheers,
Liam
Director of IT Operations
Atlantic Medical Center
liam.oconnor@atlanticmedical.com

Date: 2026-05-22T11:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed time (May 25)

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up. May 27 works on our side. How about Wednesday, May 27 at 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET? Sean (solutions engineer) and Marissa (AE) will join to cover the ops and pricing questions.

Also: since you mentioned site visits, would you prefer we run the demo virtually (recommended if your team will be moving between clinics) or would you like a short in-person intro while you're on site? If in-person, we can keep it to 30 minutes and focus on the immediate integration points — otherwise a virtual 45-minute demo will be best.

I've attached the local site visit logistics that your team shared earlier so we can coordinate timing if you opt for in-person (Local_site_visit_schedule.xlsx).

If 11:00 AM PT works, I'll send a calendar invite and a dial-in.

Thanks — Camila
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Local_site_visit_schedule.xlsx

From: Natalie Perez <natalie.perez@atlanticmedical.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlanticmedical.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-27T16:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed time (May 25)

Hi Camila — 11:00 AM PT on Wednesday (May 27) works for us. We will be on-site that day but the team will be moving between clinics, so virtual is preferable.

I'll add a couple of folks from our clinical engineering team to the calendar. Please send the invite and dial-in when you have it. Looking forward to the demo.

Best,
Natalie Perez
Project Manager, Clinical Systems
Atlantic Medical Center
